title: 长程语言智能体中的重尾记忆痕迹
summary: 论文指出智能体记忆评估缺失了记忆使用形态这一维度，在有限上下文与重复检索下记忆会集中于核心而留下长尾。作者提出基于排名的记忆控制器CTWM，用单一指数τ分配提示预算并保留摘要尾部，在多个基准上减少token并降低尾部预测误差。
summary_en: This paper argues that agent memory evaluation misses the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, memory concentrates on a core while rare states form a long tail where errors accumulate. The authors propose Core-Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller allocating prompt budget with a single exponent τ while retaining a summarized tail, reducing prompt tokens and tail prediction error across benchmarks.
